shortDescription: Manages floating IPs on the cloudscale.ch IaaS service

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for calls to the cloudscale.ch API. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_TIMEOUT) environment variable.

options.name: api_token
options.description: cloudscale.ch API token. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: api_url
options.description: cloudscale.ch API URL. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_URL) environment variable.

options.name: ip_version
options.description: IP protocol version of the floating IP. Required when assigning a new floating IP.

options.name: name
options.description: Name to identifiy the floating IP address for idempotency. One of I(network) or I(name) is required to identify the floating IP. Required for assigning a new floating IP.

options.name: network
options.description: Floating IP address to change. One of I(network) or I(name) is required to identify the floating IP.

options.name: prefix_length
options.description: Only valid if I(ip_version) is 6. Prefix length for the IPv6 network. Currently only a prefix of /56 can be requested. If no I(prefix_length) is present, a single address is created.

options.name: region
options.description: Region in which the floating IP resides (e.g. C(lpg) or C(rma)). If omitted, the region of the project default zone is used. This parameter must be omitted if I(type) is set to C(global).

options.name: reverse_ptr
options.description: Reverse PTR entry for this address. You cannot set a reverse PTR entry for IPv6 floating networks. Reverse PTR entries are only allowed for single addresses.

options.name: server
options.description: UUID of the server assigned to this floating IP.

options.name: tags
options.description: Tags associated with the floating IP. Set this to C({}) to clear any tags.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of the floating IP.
